scope: Current edition only. Fixed legacy, annotations, correct segmentation, unrelated identifiers and custom JSON behavior preserved. No intermediate edition or old-spelling aliases introduced.

actual_forward_runtime.scope: Runtime sample of approved roots, all recorded target-family surface keys, endings, case, @ forms and known regressions. Exhaustive rule-table invariants are separate.

all_inverse_key_and_suffix_checks.limitations: Finite every-key and suffix audit; actual forward captures are validated separately. Fixed legacy retains all old forms; no intermediate aliases were added.

local_streamlit_ui.scope: Independent local Streamlit AppTest, read-only regeneration replay and asset review; not Cloud observations
local_streamlit_ui.annotation_note: Existing short annotations are preserved byte-for-byte, not expanded to all senses. JA has almenaŭ 少なくとも, forniks 円蓋, karen 竜骨, and naŭz 吐き気を催させる; full semantic definitions remain in the source glosses.
local_streamlit_ui.plain_inverse_shared_spelling_note: Current plain inverse shares 船底 between karen and ŝip+fund, and 恶心 between naŭz and malic+kor. Exact-root keys take priority; fixed legacy and original forward compound segmentation remain unchanged. All HTML fixture routes recover the original spelling exactly.

generator_stage_replay.method: Read-only source inspection and in-memory approved-stage replay
generator_stage_replay.limitation: No full historical regeneration was run; current authority and all current word pairs were replayed through approved stages in memory.

plain_inverse_shared_spelling_note: 船底 is shared by karen and ŝip+fund; 恶心 by naŭz and malic+kor. The new exact-root keys have priority. The compounds and their forward segmentation are not changed. Ruby HTML retains the original source spelling.
